blocks.x: Applied AI & GenAI insights — from enterprise strategy to production models — ai that answers to the p&l.
Notes from the Applied AI & Generative AI practice: what we are seeing across engagements, what the numbers say, and where the pattern is moving.
Delivery notes grounded in live programs, benchmark results with their classical baselines, and honest negative results — the perspectives we wish vendors published when we were on the buying side.

items: The retrieval layer is the moat, not the model
Foundation models are converging on capability; the durable advantage sits in retrieval, permissions and freshness.
GenAI unit economics: the metric nobody tracks
Cost per resolved task — not per token — is the real unit of GenAI economics.
Fine-tuning is a governance decision, not a modeling one
The question is not whether to fine-tune but who owns the resulting model risk.
